headline: Prime-angle SSE at chest-high — fun early before the SW builds.
today: Best-looking of the three today with a prime angle SSE at 6s and shoulder-high sets. Wind's a manageable SW cross-on early then climbs past 12mph by afternoon, so surf the dawn and morning. Fish or groveler, and work the tide around that late-morning high.

daysToWatch.note: Swell jumps to 5ft-plus on a prime angle, but the SSW wind howls 22mph through the day and 27mph by evening. Cross-on and blown — maybe a scrappy dawn look, otherwise a warning day.
The one to circle. Head-high S swell to 4.5ft with a glassy light NNE morning after a cross dawn. Best window of the week — clear your schedule for the morning.
Waist-to-chest on a good angle with a near-glassy light dawn before the cross-on fills in. Solid early session if you get on it.
